title: Medical Officer — Shalom Medical Center
summary: Shalom Medical Center, a growing health facility in Namayingo, is seeking a dedicated and passionate Medical Officer (MBChB/MD) to join its team.
description:
Shalom Medical Center is a growing health facility committed to providing quality, compassionate, and affordable healthcare to our community in Namayingo.

We are seeking a dedicated and passionate MEDICAL OFFICER to join our team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Diagnose and treat patients in OPD, inpatient, and emergency departments
- Conduct ward rounds, clerking, and patient management
- Perform minor surgical procedures and assist in emergency care
- Supervise nurses, clinical officers, and other health workers
- Maintain accurate medical records and compile reports
- Promote health education and community outreach

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB/MD) from a recognized institution
- Valid registration with Uganda Medical and Dental Practitioners Council
- At least 1 year working experience preferred, but fresh graduates with internship completion are encouraged to apply
- Good clinical skills, teamwork, and patient-centered attitude
- Ability to work under pressure and on call
how_to_apply:
Interested candidates should submit:
1. Application letter
2. Updated CV with 3 referees
3. Copies of academic documents, internship certificate, and UMDPC licence

Send by email to muzaalerichard1@gmail.com or robinahmunywani@gmail.com, call 0778604030 / 0704601406, or hand deliver to Shalom Medical Center, Namayingo Town.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Shalom Medical Center is an equal opportunity employer. We serve with compassion, integrity, and excellence.
